subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses. 1×5= 5 Road accident frequently occurs in Bangladesh. In recent years it has increased in an (a) ----- (alarm) ----- rate. There are different reasons behind road accident. The drivers are (b) ----- (basic) ----- responsible for it. Most of them hardly know the traffic rules. Even if they know, they often try to (c) ----- (obey) ----- them and ride there vehicles wantonly and (d) -- --- careless -----. Unfortunately it gives birth to many (e) ----- (sorrow) ----- events.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both: (a) alarming; (b) basically; (c) disobey; (d) carelessly; (e) sorrowful.
